Our Mission Through the strength of our people and technology, we empower ambition and transform complexity into clarity Our Values Collaboration We create impact together. Excellence We build with purpose and precision. Innovation We imagine the future, then build it. Our vision is to build a connected future where brilliant minds and advanced technologies converge to simplify the complex, exemplify trust and reduce friction to accelerate progress. We take all feedback that we receive from our stakeholders seriously and, where possible, maintain an open dialogue to ensure that we fulfil our own ESG requirements. In addition to sharing ESG accomplishments to date, we know it’s important to share future goals to maintain accountability and success rate. The Team Our Executive Committee Mathias Strasser Founder  Mathias has practised law for more than 20 years, and has worked in the legal tech world for over ten years. He has broad legal experience and is a recognised expert in derivatives law and automation, having founded WallStreetDocs, RegXchange, PRIIP Cloud, and Scissero. Mathias holds an LL.M. from Harvard Law School, and a Mag.Jur and a Dr.Jur in law from the University of Vienna. Stephen Britton Chief Operating Officer  Stephen has 19 years of experience in the finance industry, with a track record of leading and executing complex projects. Prior to joining WSD, Stephen worked at Barclays Investment Bank, delivering a global electronic platform for cross-asset structured products. Stephen fosters financial literacy and career development through strategic partnerships with local charities. Stephen holds a BA in Economics and Philosophy from Nottingham University. Stephen Hender Chief Product and Technology Officer  Stephen leads the firm's technology and product strategy across its global business, overseeing architecture, engineering, product, QA, and controls functions to deliver scalable, modern platforms. A software developer and architect by background, he has deep expertise in designing large-scale, cloud-native systems. With over 20 years in Front Office, Risk, and Finance technology, Stephen has held senior leadership roles at S&P Global, Deutsche Bank, Barclays, and RBS, delivering major regulatory programmes and transformation initiatives. Cegaware :: product.text: Cegaware | Financial derivatives management top of page Master your derivatives A complete solution to manage your derivatives and structured products Pricing Risks P&L Seamless ​ Flexible Affordable Seamless pricing across these asset classes Equities FX Interest Rates Crypto Products Cegaware works hand in hand with your workflow Web Application Access insights through a modern web interface and interactive dashboards. Public API Integrate seamlessly into your existing systems using our robust public API. C++ Library Achieve low-level integration with your system using our cross-platform C++ library. Python Package Build custom workflows and run advanced analytics using our flexible Python package. ​ Services Cegaware is more flexible, modern and cost effective Real-Time Pricing Independent pricing of derivatives and structured products in real time using the latest innovations in quantitative finance with full transparency. P&L Monitoring Track your daily P&L with clear, intuitive breakdowns, visualize risk exposures, and make informed decisions with full portfolio control. Risk Analytics Analyze risk exposure with live Greeks, scenario shocks, and ladder-based sensitivity tools to monitor positions and optimize your strategy. Lifecycle Tracking Monitor contract evolution with automated lifecycle updates and alerts, keeping track of key dates, events, and changes effortlessly. Support We are by your side for a daily and immediate support Design Any Payoff with Ease : Go beyond standard templates. Our proprietary Domain Specific Language (DSL) enables the integration of complex, custom payoff structures seamlessly, accelerating your time-to-market for innovative products. ​ Extensive Learning Resources : Get started quickly and master the platform with our comprehensive tutorials, API documentation, and a knowledge base filled with practical guides and best practices. ​ Drive Innovation with Custom R&D : Partner with our Quantitative Engineering team. Propose new features or models through our dedicated R&D process, designed to evaluate and prioritize client-driven requests. ​ Secure & Reliable Data Feeds: We ensure robust, encrypted connections to leading market data providers, guaranteeing the integrity and availability of your critical data. ​ Professional Issue Resolution: Our transparent ticketing system ensures efficient tracking, prioritization, and resolution, with timely updates until your query is fully closed. Why Cegaware ? Risk manage a portfolio of derivatives and structured products is a very technical and heavy task that requires a robust and easily maintainable pricing engine to produce accurate and reliable analytics at a reasonable computational cost. ​ ​ Along the years, costly and complex solutions have been proposed to practitioners, hardly maintainable and costing too much for the users and the provider ​​s in terms of time and workforce. At Cegaware, we: ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​​​ Offer a unified framework to ease your derivatives management with full flexibility to integrate new payoffs and features Use optimized and modern infrastructure such as a smooth and friendly graphical user interface Maintain a comprehensive ecosystem of products at a very low cost and easily integrable within your workflows Provide a personnalized and reactive support , open to new ideas and projects to enhance your experience. About Cegaware FAQs What is Cegaware ? Cegaware is a modern fintech platform based in Dubai that provides pricing, risk analytics, and P&L tracking for derivatives and structured products. It combines flexibility, transparency, and cost-effectiveness compared to legacy solutions. Does Cegaware distribute market data ? No, Cegaware does not provide market data. You first need to subscribe to any external market data providers and then we will be able to help you to plug your providers to your own package of Cegaware for a complete experience. Upon subscrition to our service, we take in charge the developement of a specific API to execute market data requests to your providers. Does Cegaware trade for me ? No, Cegaware is not a trading platform but a software that produces advanced quantitative analytics to help you to understand your positions. At the end of the day, you are the one who make the trading decisions and are responsible for executing them. Can Cegaware handle my payoff ? Yes. Let us explain further: 1 - The software defines any financial contract by a simple, intuitive and generic language that aims to cover all kind of contracts. 2 - The user can use this language to design and book any contracts. 3 - The user can also use pre-defined contract template (autocall, vanilla, swap, ...). 4 - If you can't find a template that suits your needs, we can add it very quickly thanks to the generic contract description language. Our whole code base is built around this efficient technology. Does Cegaware store my market data or my external providers API keys ? No, we have not set any algorithms for this. This is not the aim of the service we provide. Your credentials will only be used to connect to your providers and request the data. The data that is pulled by our API at runtime will only be used to perform your request. At the end of every request, the connections to your providers are released. How is Cegaware different from traditional systems like Murex, Numerix, or Bloomberg? Unlike legacy systems, Cegaware is lightweight, highly customizable, and significantly more cost-effective. We focus on agility, faster time-to-market, and seamless integration into your existing infrastructure. How does Cegaware integrate with my existing systems? We provide multiple integration options: A public API for real-time interaction with your workflows. A Python package for scripting and automation. A DLL interface for integration with multiple programming languages. A modern web app with intuitive dashboards. Can I trust Cegaware’s pricing and risk analytics? Yes. Our pricing engine is independent, transparent, and based on the latest advances in quantitative finance. We ensure reproducibility and clarity in all calculations. What kind of risk analysis does Cegaware offer? Cegaware provides live Greeks, scenario shocks, ladder-based sensitivity tools, and P&L explanations, giving you a complete and intuitive view of your exposures. Who are Cegaware’s clients? Our platform is designed for investment banks, asset managers, brokers, family offices, and financial institutions seeking a modern alternative to expensive, rigid legacy systems. How long does it take to deploy Cegaware? Deployment is fast and flexible. Thanks to our modular architecture and open API, integration can be achieved within weeks rather than months or years. How can I see Cegaware in action? We offer 30-minute demos tailored to your needs. You can see how Cegaware fits into your workflow, test the platform, and explore potential synergies. How is market data handled? With Cegaware, we offer flexible market data integration options depending on the client’s preferences: • 𝐋𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐀𝐏𝐈 𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐧𝐞𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 to your preferred data provider (e.g. curves, vol surfaces, FX spot, etc.). We develop the necessary connectors to fetch real-time data directly into the engine. • 𝐇𝐨𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐝 𝐦𝐚𝐫𝐤𝐞𝐭 𝐝𝐚𝐭𝐚𝐛𝐚𝐬𝐞𝐬 on our/your side, allowing clients to contribute and retrieve their own quotes efficiently, reducing both latency and cost at pricing time. • 𝐌𝐚𝐧𝐮𝐚𝐥 𝐟𝐢𝐥𝐞 𝐮𝐩𝐥𝐨𝐚𝐝, where users can submit their own market data files. We adapt the platform to interpret the structure, as long as it follows a simple and documented format. This setup ensures clients can use the approach that best fits their infrastructure and operational needs. bottom of page
